WITH 
-- All sessions with transactions in Feb 2017
transaction_sessions AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    date,
    visitStartTime,
    device.deviceCategory
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) as h
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170201' AND '20170228'
    AND h.transaction.transactionId IS NOT NULL
),
-- First transaction date and device for each visitor in Feb 2017
first_txn AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    date as first_txn_date,
    visitStartTime,
    deviceCategory
  FROM transaction_sessions
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId ORDER BY date, visitStartTime) = 1
),
-- All Feb 2017 sessions for visitors who transacted
all_feb_sessions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    fullVisitorId,
    date as first_visit_date
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170201' AND '20170228'
    AND fullVisitorId IN (SELECT fullVisitorId FROM transaction_sessions)
),
-- First visit date in Feb for each transacting visitor
first_visit AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    MIN(first_visit_date) as first_visit_date
  FROM all_feb_sessions
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId
)
SELECT 
  ftv.fullVisitorId,
  ftv.first_visit_date,
  ftx.first_txn_date,
  DATE_DIFF(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', ftx.first_txn_date), PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', ftv.first_visit_date), DAY) as days_elapsed,
  ftx.deviceCategory
FROM first_visit ftv
JOIN first_txn ftx ON ftv.fullVisitorId = ftx.fullVisitorId
ORDER BY ftv.fullVisitorId

SELECT 
  t.trafficSource.source as traffic_source,
  t.date as sale_date,
  SUM(p.productRevenue) as product_revenue
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_20170101` as t,
UNNEST(t.hits) as h,
UNNEST(h.product) as p
WHERE t.trafficSource.source = '(direct)'
  AND p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY traffic_source, sale_date

WITH session_data AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    date,
    totals.pageviews as pageviews,
    totals.transactions as transactions,
    MAX(p.productRevenue) as max_product_revenue
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h
  LEFT JOIN UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170401' AND '20170731'
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId, date, totals.pageviews, totals.transactions
),
classified AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    date,
    pageviews,
    CASE 
      WHEN transactions >= 1 AND max_product_revenue IS NOT NULL THEN 'purchase'
      WHEN transactions IS NULL AND max_product_revenue IS NULL THEN 'non-purchase'
      ELSE 'other'
    END as session_type
  FROM session_data
  WHERE (transactions >= 1 AND max_product_revenue IS NOT NULL)
     OR (transactions IS NULL AND max_product_revenue IS NULL)
)
SELECT 
  DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH) as month,
  session_type,
  ROUND(AVG(pageviews), 2) as avg_pageviews
FROM classified
GROUP BY month, session_type
ORDER BY month, session_type

-- Final verification: show the top product with full details
WITH youtube_buyers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fullVisitorId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h,
  UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170701' AND '20170731'
    AND p.v2ProductCategory = 'Home/Shop by Brand/YouTube/'
    AND p.productQuantity IS NOT NULL
    AND p.productQuantity > 0
),
qualifying_hits AS (
  SELECT fullVisitorId, p.v2ProductName, p.productQuantity
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h,
  UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170701' AND '20170731'
    AND fullVisitorId IN (SELECT fullVisitorId FROM youtube_buyers)
    AND p.v2ProductName IS NOT NULL
    AND p.productQuantity IS NOT NULL
    AND p.productQuantity > 0
    AND LOWER(p.v2ProductName) NOT LIKE '%youtube%'
)
SELECT v2ProductName, SUM(productQuantity) AS total_quantity
FROM qualifying_hits
GROUP BY v2ProductName
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH daily_counts AS (
  SELECT DATE(timestamp) as incident_date, COUNT(*) as daily_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.austin_incidents.incidents_2016`
  WHERE descript = 'PUBLIC INTOXICATION'
  GROUP BY incident_date
),
stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(daily_count) as mean_count, STDDEV(daily_count) as stddev_count
  FROM daily_counts
),
with_z AS (
  SELECT 
    dc.incident_date,
    dc.daily_count,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(dc.daily_count - s.mean_count, s.stddev_count) as z_score
  FROM daily_counts dc
  CROSS JOIN stats s
)
SELECT incident_date
FROM with_z
ORDER BY z_score DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

-- Final answer query
WITH sessions_with_home_prefix AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fullVisitorId, visitId, visitStartTime
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_201701*`, UNNEST(hits) as hit
  WHERE trafficSource.campaign LIKE '%Data Share%'
    AND hit.page.pagePath LIKE '/home%'
    AND hit.type = 'PAGE'
),
home_hits AS (
  SELECT s.fullVisitorId, s.visitId, s.visitStartTime,
         hit.hitNumber, hit.time, hit.page.pagePath
  FROM sessions_with_home_prefix s
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_201701*` sess
    ON s.fullVisitorId = sess.fullVisitorId AND s.visitId = sess.visitId
  , UNNEST(sess.hits) as hit
  WHERE hit.page.pagePath = '/home' AND hit.type = 'PAGE'
),
next_page_hits AS (
  SELECT h.fullVisitorId, h.visitId, h.visitStartTime, h.hitNumber as home_hitNumber, h.time as home_time, h.pagePath as home_pagePath,
         nh.hitNumber as next_hitNumber, nh.time as next_time, nh.page.pagePath as next_pagePath
  FROM home_hits h
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_201701*` sess
    ON h.fullVisitorId = sess.fullVisitorId AND h.visitId = sess.visitId
  , UNNEST(sess.hits) as nh
  WHERE nh.type = 'PAGE'
    AND nh.hitNumber = (
      SELECT MIN(h2.hitNumber)
      FROM UNNEST(sess.hits) as h2
      WHERE h2.type = 'PAGE' AND h2.hitNumber > h.hitNumber
    )
),
next_page_counts AS (
  SELECT next_pagePath, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM next_page_hits
  GROUP BY next_pagePath
  ORDER BY cnt DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
max_time AS (
  SELECT MAX(CAST(next_time - home_time AS FLOAT64) / 1000) as max_time_on_home_seconds
  FROM next_page_hits
)
SELECT np.next_pagePath as most_common_next_page, 
       CAST(mt.max_time_on_home_seconds AS INT64) as max_time_on_home_seconds
FROM next_page_counts np, max_time mt

WITH traffic_source_revenue AS (
  SELECT trafficSource.source as source,
         SUM(totals.totalTransactionRevenue) as total_rev
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_2017*`
  WHERE totals.totalTransactionRevenue IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY trafficSource.source
),
top_source AS (
  SELECT source
  FROM traffic_source_revenue
  ORDER BY total_rev DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH) as month,
         SUM(totals.totalTransactionRevenue) as monthly_rev
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_2017*`
  WHERE trafficSource.source = (SELECT source FROM top_source)
    AND totals.totalTransactionRevenue IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY month
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT source FROM top_source) as traffic_source,
  ROUND((MAX(monthly_rev) - MIN(monthly_rev)) / 1000000, 2) as diff_in_millions
FROM monthly_revenue

WITH qualifying_customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fullVisitorId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS h
  LEFT JOIN UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170701' AND '20170731'
    AND p.v2ProductName = 'YouTube Men's Vintage Henley'
    AND p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT p.v2ProductName AS product_name,
       SUM(p.productQuantity) AS total_quantity
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
UNNEST(hits) AS h
LEFT JOIN UNNEST(h.product) AS p
WHERE p.v2ProductName IS NOT NULL
  AND p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL
  AND p.v2ProductName != 'YouTube Men's Vintage Henley'
  AND fullVisitorId IN (SELECT fullVisitorId FROM qualifying_customers)
GROUP BY p.v2ProductName
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH engagement_7day AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`, UNNEST(event_params) AS ep
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201101' AND '20210131'
    AND ep.key = 'engagement_time_msec'
    AND ep.value.int_value > 0
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20210101' AND '20210107'
),
engagement_2day AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`, UNNEST(event_params) AS ep
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201101' AND '20210131'
    AND ep.key = 'engagement_time_msec'
    AND ep.value.int_value > 0
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20210106' AND '20210107'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_distinct_pseudo_users
FROM engagement_7day e7
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM engagement_2day e2 WHERE e2.user_pseudo_id = e7.user_pseudo_id
)

WITH daily AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    new_confirmed,
    LAG(new_confirmed) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS prev_new_confirmed
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_open_data.covid19_open_data`
  WHERE country_name = 'United States of America' AND country_code = 'US' AND aggregation_level = 0
    AND date BETWEEN '2020-03-01' AND '2020-04-30'
)
SELECT 
  FORMAT_DATE('%m-%d', date) AS mm_dd,
  new_confirmed,
  prev_new_confirmed,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(new_confirmed - prev_new_confirmed, prev_new_confirmed) AS growth_rate
FROM daily
WHERE prev_new_confirmed IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY growth_rate DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    provider_city,
    SUM(total_discharges) AS city_discharges,
    SUM(average_total_payments * total_discharges) / SUM(total_discharges) AS weighted_avg_total_payment
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.inpatient_charges_2014`
WHERE drg_definition = '470 - MAJOR JOINT REPLACEMENT OR REATTACHMENT OF LOWER EXTREMITY W/O MCC'
GROUP BY provider_city
ORDER BY city_discharges DESC
LIMIT 3

-- The question asks for exactly 1 row - the route with the LONGEST average bike duration among those faster than yellow taxis
-- Let me get just the top 1 result

WITH top20_bike_routes AS (
  SELECT 
    start_station_name, 
    end_station_name, 
    ROUND(start_station_latitude, 3) as start_lat,
    ROUND(start_station_longitude, 3) as start_lon,
    ROUND(end_station_latitude, 3) as end_lat,
    ROUND(end_station_longitude, 3) as end_lon,
    COUNT(*) as trip_count,
    AVG(tripduration) as avg_bike_duration
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM starttime) = 2016
  GROUP BY start_station_name, end_station_name, start_station_latitude, start_station_longitude, end_station_latitude, end_station_longitude
  ORDER BY trip_count DESC
  LIMIT 20
),
taxi_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    ROUND(pickup_latitude, 3) as start_lat,
    ROUND(pickup_longitude, 3) as start_lon,
    ROUND(dropoff_latitude, 3) as end_lat,
    ROUND(dropoff_longitude, 3) as end_lon,
    AVG(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(dropoff_datetime, pickup_datetime, SECOND)) as avg_taxi_duration
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tlc_yellow_trips_2016`
  WHERE pickup_longitude IS NOT NULL 
    AND pickup_latitude IS NOT NULL
    AND dropoff_longitude IS NOT NULL 
    AND dropoff_latitude IS NOT NULL
    AND TIMESTAMP_DIFF(dropoff_datetime, pickup_datetime, SECOND) > 0
    AND trip_distance > 0
  GROUP BY ROUND(pickup_latitude, 3), ROUND(pickup_longitude, 3), ROUND(dropoff_latitude, 3), ROUND(dropoff_longitude, 3)
)
SELECT 
  b.start_station_name,
  b.end_station_name,
  b.avg_bike_duration
FROM top20_bike_routes b
JOIN taxi_avg t 
  ON b.start_lat = t.start_lat 
  AND b.start_lon = t.start_lon
  AND b.end_lat = t.end_lat
  AND b.end_lon = t.end_lon
WHERE b.avg_bike_duration < t.avg_taxi_duration
ORDER BY b.avg_bike_duration DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH filtered_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    trip_seconds,
    fare
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.chicago_taxi_trips.taxi_trips`
  WHERE trip_seconds BETWEEN 0 AND 3600
),
with_quantile AS (
  SELECT 
    trip_seconds,
    fare,
    NTILE(6) OVER (ORDER BY trip_seconds) AS quantile_group
  FROM filtered_trips
)
SELECT 
  quantile_group,
  COUNT(*) as total_trips,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(fare), COUNT(*)) as avg_fare,
  MIN(ROUND(trip_seconds / 60.0)) as min_duration_min,
  MAX(ROUND(trip_seconds / 60.0)) as max_duration_min
FROM with_quantile
GROUP BY quantile_group
ORDER BY quantile_group

SELECT 
  ct.geo_id AS census_tract,
  ROUND(ct.median_income, 2) AS median_income,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(c.total_amt), SUM(c.contribution_count)), 2) AS avg_donation_amount
FROM (
  SELECT geo_id, median_income 
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2018_5yr` 
  WHERE geo_id LIKE '36047%'
) ct
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT 
    zc.census_tract_geoid,
    SUM(i.transaction_amt) AS total_amt,
    COUNT(*) AS contribution_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fec.indiv20` i
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.hud_zipcode_crosswalk.zipcode_to_census_tracts` zc 
    ON LEFT(i.zip_code, 5) = zc.zip_code
  WHERE i.state = 'NY'
  GROUP BY zc.census_tract_geoid
) c ON ct.geo_id = c.census_tract_geoid
GROUP BY ct.geo_id, ct.median_income
ORDER BY ct.geo_id

-- Final query: Top 10 evaluation groups by largest subplot acres for inventory year 2012
WITH condition_acres AS (
    SELECT 
        p.evaluation_group,
        p.evaluation_group_description,
        p.evaluation_type,
        p.evaluation_description,
        p.state_code,
        c.condition_status_code,
        SUM(p.expansion_factor * COALESCE(p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot, 1) * COALESCE(c.subplot_proportion_unadjusted, 0)) as subplot_acres,
        SUM(p.expansion_factor * COALESCE(p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot, 0) * COALESCE(c.macroplot_proportion_unadjusted, 0)) as macroplot_acres
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c 
        ON p.plot_sequence_number = c.plot_sequence_number 
        AND p.inventory_year = c.inventory_year
    WHERE p.inventory_year = 2012
    GROUP BY p.evaluation_group, p.evaluation_group_description, p.evaluation_type, p.evaluation_description, p.state_code, c.condition_status_code
),
group_max AS (
    SELECT 
        evaluation_group,
        evaluation_group_description,
        evaluation_type,
        evaluation_description,
        state_code,
        condition_status_code,
        macroplot_acres,
        subplot_acres,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY evaluation_group ORDER BY subplot_acres DESC) as rn
    FROM condition_acres
),
top_groups AS (
    SELECT 
        evaluation_group,
        evaluation_group_description,
        evaluation_type,
        evaluation_description,
        state_code,
        condition_status_code,
        macroplot_acres,
        subplot_acres
    FROM group_max
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT 
    evaluation_group,
    evaluation_group_description,
    evaluation_type,
    evaluation_description,
    state_code,
    condition_status_code,
    macroplot_acres,
    subplot_acres
FROM top_groups
ORDER BY subplot_acres DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH under20 AS (
  SELECT 
    country_code,
    country_name,
    SUM(population) AS total_under_20
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_international.midyear_population_agespecific`
  WHERE year = 2020 AND age BETWEEN 0 AND 19
  GROUP BY country_code, country_name
),
midyear AS (
  SELECT 
    country_code,
    country_name,
    midyear_population
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_international.midyear_population`
  WHERE year = 2020
)
SELECT 
  u.country_name,
  u.total_under_20,
  m.midyear_population,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(u.total_under_20, m.midyear_population) * 100 AS pct_under_20
FROM under20 u
JOIN midyear m ON u.country_code = m.country_code
ORDER BY pct_under_20 DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
    country_name,
    cumulative_confirmed,
    cumulative_recovered,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(cumulative_recovered, cumulative_confirmed) * 100 AS recovery_rate_pct
FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_open_data.covid19_open_data`
WHERE date = '2020-05-10' 
  AND aggregation_level = 0
  AND cumulative_confirmed > 50000
  AND cumulative_recovered IS NOT NULL
  AND cumulative_recovered <= cumulative_confirmed
ORDER BY recovery_rate_pct DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE) AS date,
    (CAST(temp AS FLOAT64) - 32) * 5.0 / 9.0 AS temp_c,
    CAST(prcp AS FLOAT64) * 2.54 AS prcp_cm,
    SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) * 0.514444 AS wdsp_ms
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2019`
  WHERE stn = '998009'
    AND year = '2019'
    AND mo IN ('01', '02', '03')
    AND temp != 9999.9
    AND prcp != 99.99
    AND wdsp != '999.9'
),
with_ma AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    ROUND(temp_c, 1) AS temp_c,
    ROUND(prcp_cm, 1) AS prcp_cm,
    ROUND(wdsp_ms, 1) AS wdsp_ms,
    ROUND(AVG(temp_c) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS temp_ma8,
    ROUND(AVG(prcp_cm) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS prcp_ma8,
    ROUND(AVG(wdsp_ms) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 7 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 1) AS wdsp_ma8
  FROM base
)
SELECT 
  date,
  temp_c,
  prcp_cm,
  wdsp_ms,
  temp_ma8,
  prcp_ma8,
  wdsp_ma8,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_lag1_diff,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_lag2_diff,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_lag3_diff,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_lag4_diff,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_lag5_diff,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_lag6_diff,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_lag7_diff,
  ROUND(temp_ma8 - LAG(temp_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS temp_lag8_diff,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prcp_lag1_diff,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prcp_lag2_diff,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prcp_lag3_diff,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prcp_lag4_diff,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prcp_lag5_diff,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prcp_lag6_diff,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prcp_lag7_diff,
  ROUND(prcp_ma8 - LAG(prcp_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS prcp_lag8_diff,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 1) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wdsp_lag1_diff,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 2) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wdsp_lag2_diff,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 3) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wdsp_lag3_diff,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 4) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wdsp_lag4_diff,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 5) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wdsp_lag5_diff,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 6) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wdsp_lag6_diff,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 7) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wdsp_lag7_diff,
  ROUND(wdsp_ma8 - LAG(wdsp_ma8, 8) OVER (ORDER BY date), 1) AS wdsp_lag8_diff
FROM with_ma
WHERE date >= '2019-01-09'
ORDER BY date

-- Get the final coordinates for TEDDY (second longest distance storm)
SELECT latitude, longitude, iso_time, usa_status
FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes`
WHERE season = '2020' AND basin = 'NA' AND name = 'TEDDY'
ORDER BY iso_time DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT id, name, latitude, longitude
FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_stations`
WHERE 
  -- Haversine distance formula in km
  6371 * ACOS(
    SIN(41.8319 * 3.141592653589793 / 180) * SIN(latitude * 3.141592653589793 / 180) +
    COS(41.8319 * 3.141592653589793 / 180) * COS(latitude * 3.141592653589793 / 180) *
    COS(longitude * 3.141592653589793 / 180 - (-87.6847) * 3.141592653589793 / 180)
  ) <= 50
ORDER BY id

WITH station_coords AS (
  SELECT station_id, latitude, longitude 
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_stations`
)
SELECT 
  t.bike_number,
  SUM(
    6371000 * ACOS(
      LEAST(1, 
        SIN(s.latitude * 3.141592653589793 / 180) * SIN(e.latitude * 3.141592653589793 / 180) + 
        COS(s.latitude * 3.141592653589793 / 180) * COS(e.latitude * 3.141592653589793 / 180) * 
        COS((e.longitude - s.longitude) * 3.141592653589793 / 180)
      )
    )
  ) AS total_distance_meters
FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_trips` t
JOIN station_coords s ON t.start_station_id = s.station_id
JOIN station_coords e ON t.end_station_id = e.station_id
GROUP BY t.bike_number
ORDER BY total_distance_meters DESC

FROM (

    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
    WHERE start_station_id = end_station_id
  ),

    FROM same_station_trips
    GROUP BY station_id, two_min_bucket
  ),
  group_windows AS (
    SELECT 
      station_id,
      two_min_bucket,
      trip_count
    FROM window_counts
    WHERE trip_count > 1
  ),
  group_rides_per_station AS (
    SELECT 
      station_id,
      SUM(trip_count) as group_rides
    FROM group_windows
    GROUP BY station_id
  ),
  total_end_trips AS (

      end_station_id,
      COUNT(*) as total_end_trips
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
    GROUP BY end_station_id

  station_names AS (

      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(t.tip_amount, t.total_amount) * 100 <= 5 THEN 'up to 5%'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(t.tip_amount, t.total_amount) * 100 > 5 AND SAFE_DIVIDE(t.tip_amount, t.total_amount) * 100 <= 10 THEN '5% to 10%'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(t.tip_amount, t.total_amount) * 100 > 10 AND SAFE_DIVIDE(t.tip_amount, t.total_amount) * 100 <= 15 THEN '10% to 15%'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(t.tip_amount, t.total_amount) * 100 > 15 AND SAFE_DIVIDE(t.tip_amount, t.total_amount) * 100 <= 20 THEN '15% to 20%'
      WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(t.tip_amount, t.total_amount) * 100 > 20 AND SAFE_DIVIDE(t.tip_amount, t.total_amount) * 100 <= 25 THEN '20% to 25%'
      ELSE 'more than 25%'
    END AS tip_category,
    COUNT(*) AS trip_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.tlc_yellow_trips_2016` t
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` tz

  WHERE
    t.pickup_datetime >= TIMESTAMP('2016-01-01')

    AND tz.borough NOT IN ('EWR', 'Staten Island')
    AND t.dropoff_datetime > t.pickup_datetime
    AND t.passenger_count > 0
    AND t.trip_distance >= 0
    AND t.tip_amount >= 0
    AND t.tolls_amount >= 0
    AND t.mta_tax >= 0
    AND t.fare_amount >= 0
    AND t.total_amount >= 0
  GROUP BY tz.borough, tip_category
)

  pickup_borough,

  SAFE_DIVIDE(trip_count, SUM(trip_count) OVER (PARTITION BY pickup_borough)) AS proportion

),
top2015 AS (
  SELECT latin, spc_common, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY latin ORDER BY cnt DESC) as rn
  FROM c2015_common
),
species_common AS (
  SELECT 
    UPPER(ts.species_scientific_name) as latin,
    COALESCE(ts.species_common_name, top1995.spc_common, top2015.spc_common) as common_name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tree_species` ts
  LEFT JOIN top1995 ON UPPER(ts.species_scientific_name) = top1995.latin AND top1995.rn = 1
  LEFT JOIN top2015 ON UPPER(ts.species_scientific_name) = top2015.latin AND top2015.rn = 1
),
joined AS (
  SELECT 
    y1995_counts.latin,
    COALESCE(species_common.common_name, top1995.spc_common, top2015.spc_common) as common_name,
    y1995_counts.total_1995,
    y2015_counts.total_2015,
    y1995_counts.alive_1995,
    y2015_counts.alive_2015,
    y1995_counts.dead_1995,
    y2015_counts.dead_2015,
    y2015_counts.total_2015 - y1995_counts.total_1995 as growth_total,
    y2015_counts.alive_2015 - y1995_counts.alive_1995 as growth_alive,
    y2015_counts.dead_2015 - y1995_counts.dead_1995 as growth_dead
  FROM y1995_counts
  JOIN y2015_counts ON y1995_counts.latin = y2015_counts.latin
  LEFT JOIN species_common ON y1995_counts.latin = species_common.latin
  LEFT JOIN top1995 ON y1995_counts.latin = top1995.latin AND top1995.rn = 1
  LEFT JOIN top2015 ON y1995_counts.latin = top2015.latin AND top2015.rn = 1
)
SELECT latin, common_name, total_1995, total_2015, alive_1995, alive_2015, dead_1995, dead_2015, growth_total, growth_alive, growth_dead
FROM joined
ORDER BY growth_total DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH bls_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(percent_white) as avg_white,
        AVG(percent_black_or_african_american) as avg_black,
        AVG(percent_asian) as avg_asian,
        AVG(percent_hispanic_or_latino) as avg_hispanic
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls.cpsaat18` 
    WHERE year = 2021 
    AND (subsector IN ('Internet publishing and broadcasting and web search portals', 'Software publishers', 'Data processing, hosting, and related services') 
    OR (industry_group = 'Computer systems design and related services' AND subsector = 'Professional and technical services'))
),
google AS (
    SELECT race_white, race_black, race_asian, race_hispanic_latinx
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_dei.dar_non_intersectional_hiring`
    WHERE report_year = 2021 AND workforce = 'overall'
),
race_diffs AS (
    SELECT 'White' as race, ABS(g.race_white - b.avg_white) * 100 as pct_diff
    FROM google g, bls_avg b
    UNION ALL SELECT 'Black or African American', ABS(g.race_black - b.avg_black) * 100
    FROM google g, bls_avg b
    UNION ALL SELECT 'Asian', ABS(g.race_asian - b.avg_asian) * 100
    FROM google g, bls_avg b
    UNION ALL SELECT 'Hispanic or Latinx', ABS(g.race_hispanic_latinx - b.avg_hispanic) * 100
    FROM google g, bls_avg b
)
SELECT race, ROUND(pct_diff, 2) as pct_diff
FROM race_diffs
ORDER BY pct_diff DESC
LIMIT 3

-- Highest average speed for Berkeley trips > 1000m
SELECT ROUND(MAX(SAFE_DIVIDE(ST_DISTANCE(start_station.station_geom, end_station.station_geom), t.duration_sec)), 1) as highest_avg_speed_mps

SELECT b.country_name, b.net_migration
FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_international.birth_death_growth_rates` b

WITH cal_2015 AS (

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2015_5yr`
  WHERE geo_id LIKE '06%' AND median_income IS NOT NULL
),
cal_2018 AS (
  SELECT geo_id, median_income AS median_income_2018
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2018_5yr`
  WHERE geo_id LIKE '06%' AND median_income IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  a.geo_id,
  a.median_income_2015,
  b.median_income_2018,
  b.median_income_2018 - a.median_income_2015 AS increase

WITH target_zips AS (
    SELECT zip_code, zip_code_geom
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes`
    WHERE ST_DISTANCE(internal_point_geom, ST_GEOGPOINT(-122.191667, 47.685833)) < 5 * 1609.344
),
tract_zip_alloc AS (
    SELECT 
        t.geo_id,
        z.zip_code,
        SAFE_DIVIDE(
            ST_AREA(ST_INTERSECTION(t.tract_geom, z.zip_code_geom)),
            ST_AREA(t.tract_geom)
        ) as allocation_ratio,
        a.total_pop,
        a.income_per_capita
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_census_tracts.census_tracts_washington` t
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2017_5yr` a
        ON t.geo_id = a.geo_id
    JOIN target_zips z
        ON ST_INTERSECTS(t.tract_geom, z.zip_code_geom)
    WHERE a.total_pop > 0
)
SELECT 
    zip_code,
    ROUND(SUM(total_pop * allocation_ratio), 0) as total_population,
    ROUND(SUM(total_pop * allocation_ratio * income_per_capita) / NULLIF(SUM(total_pop * allocation_ratio), 0), 1) as avg_individual_income
FROM tract_zip_alloc
GROUP BY zip_code
ORDER BY avg_individual_income DESC

WITH births AS (
  SELECT 
    County_of_Residence_FIPS,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM Year) as birth_year,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Maternal_Morbidity_YN = 1 THEN Births ELSE 0 END) as no_morbidity_births,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Maternal_Morbidity_YN IN (0, 1) THEN Births ELSE 0 END) as total_with_morbidity_info
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_cdc_wonder_natality.county_natality_by_maternal_morbidity`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM Year) BETWEEN 2016 AND 2018 AND Maternal_Morbidity_YN IN (0, 1)
  GROUP BY County_of_Residence_FIPS, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM Year)
),
data_2016 AS (
  SELECT 
    b.County_of_Residence_FIPS,
    CAST(b.no_morbidity_births AS FLOAT64) / CAST(b.total_with_morbidity_info AS FLOAT64) as pct_no_morbidity,
    CAST(c.poverty AS FLOAT64) / NULLIF(CAST(c.pop_determined_poverty_status AS FLOAT64), 0) as poverty_rate
  FROM births b
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2015_5yr` c 
    ON LPAD(b.County_of_Residence_FIPS, 5, '0') = c.geo_id
  WHERE b.birth_year = 2016 
    AND c.pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
),
data_2017 AS (
  SELECT 
    b.County_of_Residence_FIPS,
    CAST(b.no_morbidity_births AS FLOAT64) / CAST(b.total_with_morbidity_info AS FLOAT64) as pct_no_morbidity,
    CAST(c.poverty AS FLOAT64) / NULLIF(CAST(c.pop_determined_poverty_status AS FLOAT64), 0) as poverty_rate
  FROM births b
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2016_5yr` c 
    ON LPAD(b.County_of_Residence_FIPS, 5, '0') = c.geo_id
  WHERE b.birth_year = 2017 
    AND c.pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
),
data_2018 AS (
  SELECT 
    b.County_of_Residence_FIPS,
    CAST(b.no_morbidity_births AS FLOAT64) / CAST(b.total_with_morbidity_info AS FLOAT64) as pct_no_morbidity,
    CAST(c.poverty AS FLOAT64) / NULLIF(CAST(c.pop_determined_poverty_status AS FLOAT64), 0) as poverty_rate
  FROM births b
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2017_5yr` c 
    ON LPAD(b.County_of_Residence_FIPS, 5, '0') = c.geo_id
  WHERE b.birth_year = 2018 
    AND c.pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
),
combined AS (
  SELECT 2016 as year, poverty_rate, pct_no_morbidity FROM data_2016
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 2017 as year, poverty_rate, pct_no_morbidity FROM data_2017
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 2018 as year, poverty_rate, pct_no_morbidity FROM data_2018
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    year,
    COUNT(*) as n,
    SUM(poverty_rate) as sum_x,
    SUM(pct_no_morbidity) as sum_y,
    SUM(poverty_rate * pct_no_morbidity) as sum_xy,
    SUM(poverty_rate * poverty_rate) as sum_x2,
    SUM(pct_no_morbidity * pct_no_morbidity) as sum_y2
  FROM combined
  GROUP BY year
)
SELECT 
  year,
  n,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y,
    SQRT((n * sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x) * (n * sum_y2 - sum_y * sum_y))
  ) as pearson_correlation
FROM stats

WITH person_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    state_number,
    consecutive_number,
    COUNT(DISTINCT person_number) as num_persons,
    SUM(CASE WHEN injury_severity = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as num_fatal_injuries
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.person_2016`
  GROUP BY state_number, consecutive_number
),
vehicle_agg AS (
  SELECT 
    state_number,
    consecutive_number,
    STRING_AGG(DISTINCT CAST(body_type AS STRING), ',') as body_types,
    AVG(ABS(CAST(travel_speed AS FLOAT64) - CAST(speed_limit AS FLOAT64))) as avg_speed_diff
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.vehicle_2016`
  WHERE travel_speed NOT IN (997, 998, 999)
    AND speed_limit NOT IN (98, 99)
    AND travel_speed IS NOT NULL
    AND speed_limit IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY state_number, consecutive_number
)
SELECT 
  a.state_number,
  a.consecutive_number,
  CASE WHEN pc.num_fatal_injuries > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as label,
  va.body_types,
  a.number_of_drunk_drivers,
  a.day_of_week,
  a.hour_of_crash,
  CASE WHEN SAFE_CAST(a.work_zone AS INT64) != 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as work_zone_binary,
  va.avg_speed_diff,
  CASE 
    WHEN va.avg_speed_diff < 20 THEN 0
    WHEN va.avg_speed_diff < 40 THEN 1
    WHEN va.avg_speed_diff < 60 THEN 2
    WHEN va.avg_speed_diff < 80 THEN 3
    ELSE 4
  END as speed_diff_category
FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.accident_2016` a
JOIN person_counts pc
  ON a.state_number = pc.state_number AND a.consecutive_number = pc.consecutive_number
JOIN vehicle_agg va
  ON a.state_number = va.state_number AND a.consecutive_number = va.consecutive_number
WHERE pc.num_persons > 1

SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM (

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2015_5yr` a2015
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2018_5yr` a2018 ON a2015.geo_id = a2018.geo_id
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_cms_dual_eligible_enrollment.dual_eligible_enrollment_by_county_and_program` de2015 
    ON a2015.geo_id = de2015.FIPS AND de2015.Date = '2015-12-01'

WITH latest_expcurr AS (
  SELECT peg.state_code, peg.evaluation_group, peg.evaluation_group_sequence_number,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY peg.state_code ORDER BY peg.evaluation_group DESC) as rn
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population_evaluation_group` peg
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population_evaluation_type` pet
    ON peg.evaluation_group_sequence_number = pet.evaluation_group_sequence_number
  WHERE pet.evaluation_type = 'EXPCURR'
),
filtered_pop AS (
  SELECT p.plot_sequence_number, p.state_code, p.evaluation_group, p.evaluation_group_sequence_number,
         p.expansion_factor,
         p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot,
         p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p
  JOIN latest_expcurr le
    ON p.evaluation_group_sequence_number = le.evaluation_group_sequence_number
    AND le.rn = 1
),
condition_acres AS (
  SELECT c.plot_sequence_number, c.state_code, c.condition_status_code, c.reserved_status_code, 
         c.site_productivity_class_code, c.proportion_basis, c.condition_proportion_unadjusted,
         fp.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot, fp.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot, fp.expansion_factor,
         fp.evaluation_group,
         CASE 
           WHEN c.proportion_basis = 'MACR' AND fp.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot > 0 
             THEN fp.expansion_factor * c.condition_proportion_unadjusted * fp.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot
           WHEN c.proportion_basis = 'SUBP' AND fp.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot > 0 
             THEN fp.expansion_factor * c.condition_proportion_unadjusted * fp.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot
           ELSE 0
         END AS adjusted_acres
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c
  JOIN filtered_pop fp
    ON c.plot_sequence_number = fp.plot_sequence_number
    AND c.state_code = fp.state_code
),
state_totals AS (
  SELECT c.state_code, c.evaluation_group,
         SUM(CASE WHEN c.condition_status_code = 1 AND c.reserved_status_code = 0 AND c.site_productivity_class_code BETWEEN 1 AND 6 THEN c.adjusted_acres ELSE 0 END) AS timberland_acres,
         SUM(CASE WHEN c.condition_status_code = 1 THEN c.adjusted_acres ELSE 0 END) AS forestland_acres
  FROM condition_acres c
  GROUP BY c.state_code, c.evaluation_group
),
timberland_ranked AS (
  SELECT state_code, evaluation_group, timberland_acres,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY timberland_acres DESC) as rn
  FROM state_totals
),
forestland_ranked AS (
  SELECT state_code, evaluation_group, forestland_acres,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY forestland_acres DESC) as rn
  FROM state_totals
),
state_names AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT state_code, state_code_name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition`
)
SELECT 
  'timberland' AS category,
  tr.state_code,
  tr.evaluation_group,
  sn.state_code_name,
  tr.timberland_acres AS total_acres
FROM timberland_ranked tr
JOIN state_names sn ON tr.state_code = sn.state_code
WHERE tr.rn = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'forestland' AS category,
  fr.state_code,
  fr.evaluation_group,
  sn.state_code_name,
  fr.forestland_acres AS total_acres
FROM forestland_ranked fr
JOIN state_names sn ON fr.state_code = sn.state_code
WHERE fr.rn = 1

WITH trips_with_region AS (
  SELECT 
    t.trip_id,
    t.duration_sec,
    t.start_date,
    t.start_station_name,
    t.member_gender,
    r.name AS region_name,
    r.region_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_id ORDER BY t.start_date DESC) as rn
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_trips` t
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_station_info` s
    ON CAST(t.start_station_id AS STRING) = s.station_id
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_regions` r
    ON s.region_id = r.region_id
  WHERE t.start_date >= '2014-01-01' AND t.start_date < '2018-01-01'
    AND s.region_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  region_name,
  trip_id,
  duration_sec,
  start_date,
  start_station_name,
  member_gender
FROM trips_with_region
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region_name

SELECT 
    c.country AS country,
    c.total_confirmed,
    p.population_2020,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(c.total_confirmed * 100000, p.population_2020) AS cases_per_100k
FROM (
    SELECT 'United States' AS country, SUM(confirmed) as total_confirmed 
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_jhu_csse.summary` 
    WHERE date = '2020-04-20' AND country_region = 'US'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'France', SUM(confirmed) FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_jhu_csse.summary` WHERE date = '2020-04-20' AND country_region = 'France'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'China', SUM(confirmed) FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_jhu_csse.summary` WHERE date = '2020-04-20' AND country_region = 'China'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Italy', SUM(confirmed) FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_jhu_csse.summary` WHERE date = '2020-04-20' AND country_region = 'Italy'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Spain', SUM(confirmed) FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_jhu_csse.summary` WHERE date = '2020-04-20' AND country_region = 'Spain'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Germany', SUM(confirmed) FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_jhu_csse.summary` WHERE date = '2020-04-20' AND country_region = 'Germany'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Iran', SUM(confirmed) FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_jhu_csse.summary` WHERE date = '2020-04-20' AND country_region = 'Iran'
) c
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 'USA' AS country_code, value AS population_2020 FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_wdi.indicators_data` WHERE indicator_code = 'SP.POP.TOTL' AND country_code = 'USA' AND year = 2020
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'FRA', value FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_wdi.indicators_data` WHERE indicator_code = 'SP.POP.TOTL' AND country_code = 'FRA' AND year = 2020
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CHN', value FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_wdi.indicators_data` WHERE indicator_code = 'SP.POP.TOTL' AND country_code = 'CHN' AND year = 2020
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'ITA', value FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_wdi.indicators_data` WHERE indicator_code = 'SP.POP.TOTL' AND country_code = 'ITA' AND year = 2020
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'ESP', value FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_wdi.indicators_data` WHERE indicator_code = 'SP.POP.TOTL' AND country_code = 'ESP' AND year = 2020
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'DEU', value FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_wdi.indicators_data` WHERE indicator_code = 'SP.POP.TOTL' AND country_code = 'DEU' AND year = 2020
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'IRN', value FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_wdi.indicators_data` WHERE indicator_code = 'SP.POP.TOTL' AND country_code = 'IRN' AND year = 2020
) p ON (CASE WHEN c.country = 'United States' THEN 'USA' ELSE c.country END) = p.country_code
ORDER BY c.country

-- Final query: percentage of each country's population confirmed with COVID-19 by June 30, 2020
SELECT 
  c.country_name,
  c.cumulative_confirmed,
  w.year_2018 as population_2018,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(c.cumulative_confirmed, w.year_2018) * 100, 4) as percentage_confirmed
FROM (
  SELECT country_name, country_code, cumulative_confirmed
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_open_data.covid19_open_data`
  WHERE date = DATE('2020-06-30')
  AND aggregation_level = 0
  AND country_code IS NOT NULL
) c
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_global_population.population_by_country` w
ON c.country_name = w.country
WHERE w.country NOT IN ('Lower middle income', 'Low income', 'High income', 'Upper middle income', 'Not classified', 'Arab World', 'East Asia & Pacific', 'Europe & Central Asia', 'Latin America & Caribbean', 'North America', 'South Asia', 'Sub-Saharan Africa', 'OECD members', 'Euro area', 'World')
AND w.year_2018 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY percentage_confirmed DESC

WITH yearly_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    SUBSTR(date, 1, 4) AS year,
    AVG(CAST(symptom_anosmia AS FLOAT64)) AS avg_weekly_freq
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_symptom_search.symptom_search_sub_region_2_weekly`
  WHERE sub_region_1 = 'New York'
    AND sub_region_2 IN ('Bronx County', 'Queens County', 'Kings County', 'New York County', 'Richmond County')
    AND date >= '2019-01-01' AND date <= '2020-12-31'
    AND symptom_anosmia IS NOT NULL AND symptom_anosmia != ''
  GROUP BY SUBSTR(date, 1, 4)
)
SELECT 
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN year = '2020' THEN avg_weekly_freq ELSE NULL END) - SUM(CASE WHEN year = '2019' THEN avg_weekly_freq ELSE NULL END), 
              SUM(CASE WHEN year = '2019' THEN avg_weekly_freq ELSE NULL END)) * 100 AS pct_change
FROM yearly_avg

SELECT 
  'United States' AS country,
  AVG(CASE WHEN date >= '2019-01-01' AND date < '2020-01-01' THEN CAST(symptom_anxiety AS FLOAT64) END) AS avg_anxiety_2019,
  AVG(CASE WHEN date >= '2019-01-01' AND date < '2020-01-01' THEN CAST(symptom_depression AS FLOAT64) END) AS avg_depression_2019,
  AVG(CASE WHEN date >= '2020-01-01' AND date < '2021-01-01' THEN CAST(symptom_anxiety AS FLOAT64) END) AS avg_anxiety_2020,
  AVG(CASE WHEN date >= '2020-01-01' AND date < '2021-01-01' THEN CAST(symptom_depression AS FLOAT64) END) AS avg_depression_2020,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    AVG(CASE WHEN date >= '2020-01-01' AND date < '2021-01-01' THEN CAST(symptom_anxiety AS FLOAT64) END) -

-- Final query: rate per 100k for all states for 2015 and 2016, then top 5 per year
WITH distracted_2015 AS (
  SELECT 
    d.state_number,
    a.state_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.consecutive_number) as distracted_accidents
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.distract_2015` d
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.accident_2015` a 
    ON d.state_number = a.state_number AND d.consecutive_number = a.consecutive_number
  WHERE d.driver_distracted_by_name NOT IN ('Not Distracted', 'Unknown if Distracted', 'Not Reported')
  GROUP BY d.state_number, a.state_name
),
distracted_2016 AS (
  SELECT 
    d.state_number,
    a.state_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.consecutive_number) as distracted_accidents
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.distract_2016` d
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.accident_2016` a 
    ON d.state_number = a.state_number AND d.consecutive_number = a.consecutive_number
  WHERE d.driver_distracted_by_name NOT IN ('Not Distracted', 'Unknown if Distracted', 'Not Reported')
  GROUP BY d.state_number, a.state_name
),
state_pop AS (
  SELECT 
    SAFE_CAST(za.state_fips AS INT64) as state_fips,
    za.state_name,
    SUM(p.population) as total_pop
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_usa.population_by_zip_2010` p
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.utility_us.zipcode_area` za ON p.zipcode = za.zipcode
  WHERE p.gender IS NULL AND p.minimum_age IS NULL
  GROUP BY SAFE_CAST(za.state_fips AS INT64), za.state_name
),
combined AS (
  SELECT 
    '2015' as year,
    d.state_number,
    d.state_name,
    d.distracted_accidents,
    sp.total_pop,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(d.distracted_accidents * 100000.0, sp.total_pop) as rate_per_100k
  FROM distracted_2015 d
  JOIN state_pop sp ON d.state_number = sp.state_fips
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    '2016' as year,
    d.state_number,
    d.state_name,
    d.distracted_accidents,
    sp.total_pop,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(d.distracted_accidents * 100000.0, sp.total_pop) as rate_per_100k
  FROM distracted_2016 d
  JOIN state_pop sp ON d.state_number = sp.state_fips
)
SELECT year, state_number, state_name, distracted_accidents, total_pop, 
       ROUND(rate_per_100k, 2) as rate_per_100k
FROM combined
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY rate_per_100k DESC) <= 5
ORDER BY year, rate_per_100k DESC

WITH rn_freq AS (
  SELECT 
    Chromosome as chr_num,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Abnormality LIKE '+%' THEN CAST(TotalCases AS INT64) ELSE 0 END) as gain_freq,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Abnormality LIKE '-%' THEN CAST(TotalCases AS INT64) ELSE 0 END) as loss_freq
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.RecurrentNumData`
  WHERE Morph = '3111' AND Topo = '0401'
  GROUP BY Chromosome
),
cc_freq AS (
  SELECT 
    SUBSTR(c.Chr, 4) as chr_num,
    c.Type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.CaseNo) as freq
  FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted` c
  JOIN `mitelman-db.prod.Cytogen` cy ON c.CaseNo = cy.CaseNo
  WHERE cy.Morph = '3111' AND cy.Topo = '0401'
  GROUP BY SUBSTR(c.Chr, 4), c.Type
)
SELECT 
  CORR(rn.gain_freq, cc_g.freq) as gain_correlation,
  CORR(rn.loss_freq, cc_l.freq) as loss_correlation
FROM rn_freq rn
JOIN cc_freq cc_g ON rn.chr_num = cc_g.chr_num AND cc_g.Type = 'Gain'
JOIN cc_freq cc_l ON rn.chr_num = cc_l.chr_num AND cc_l.Type = 'Loss'

WITH storm_tracks AS (

    sid,
    name,
    season,
    iso_time,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    usa_wind,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sid ORDER BY iso_time) as rn
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_hurricanes.hurricanes`
  WHERE basin = 'NA' 
    AND CAST(season AS STRING) = '2020'
    AND track_type = 'main'
    AND name = 'LAURA'

distances AS (
  SELECT 
    a.sid,
    a.name,
    a.season,
    a.iso_time,
    a.latitude,
    a.longitude,
    a.usa_wind,
    a.rn,
    ST_DISTANCE(
      ST_GEOGPOINT(a.longitude, a.latitude),
      ST_GEOGPOINT(b.longitude, b.latitude)
    ) / 1000.0 AS segment_km
  FROM storm_tracks a
  LEFT JOIN storm_tracks b 
    ON a.sid = b.sid AND a.rn = b.rn - 1
),
cumulative AS (
  SELECT 
    sid,
    name,
    season,
    iso_time,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    usa_wind,
    rn,
    segment_km,
    SUM(segment_km) OVER (PARTITION BY sid ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_distance_km
  FROM distances
)

  name,
  latitude,
  longitude,
  cumulative_distance_km,
  usa_wind
FROM cumulative
ORDER BY rn

-- Final query: Average correlation per sample type after filtering |corr| <= 0.5
WITH proteome_data AS (
    SELECT p.gene_symbol, a.sample_submitter_id, a.sample_type, p.protein_abundance_log2ratio
    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.CPTAC.quant_proteome_CPTAC_CCRCC_discovery_study_pdc_current` p
    JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.PDC_metadata.aliquot_to_case_mapping_current` a
      ON p.aliquot_id = a.aliquot_id
    WHERE a.sample_type IN ('Primary Tumor', 'Solid Tissue Normal')
),
rnaseq_data AS (
    SELECT r.sample_barcode, r.gene_name, r.fpkm_unstranded, r.sample_type_name
    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.CPTAC.RNAseq_hg38_gdc_current` r
    WHERE r.primary_site = 'Kidney'
      AND r.sample_type_name IN ('Primary Tumor', 'Solid Tissue Normal')
),
joined_data AS (
    SELECT p.gene_symbol, p.sample_submitter_id, p.sample_type, p.protein_abundance_log2ratio, 
           r.fpkm_unstranded, r.sample_type_name
    FROM proteome_data p
    JOIN rnaseq_data r
      ON p.sample_submitter_id = r.sample_barcode
      AND p.gene_symbol = r.gene_name
    WHERE r.fpkm_unstranded IS NOT NULL
      AND p.protein_abundance_log2ratio IS NOT NULL
),
gene_correlations AS (
    SELECT sample_type_name, gene_symbol, 
           CORR(protein_abundance_log2ratio, LOG(fpkm_unstranded + 1)) AS correlation
    FROM joined_data
    GROUP BY sample_type_name, gene_symbol
    HAVING CORR(protein_abundance_log2ratio, LOG(fpkm_unstranded + 1)) IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT sample_type_name, 
       AVG(correlation) AS avg_correlation
FROM gene_correlations
WHERE ABS(correlation) <= 0.5
GROUP BY sample_type_name

WITH paad_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT bcr_patient_barcode as patient_id
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_clinical_PANCAN_patient_with_followup`
  WHERE acronym = 'PAAD'
),

  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.pancancer_atlas.Filtered_MC3_MAF_V5_one_per_tumor_sample`
  WHERE Study = 'PAAD' AND Hugo_Symbol IN ('KRAS', 'TP53') AND FILTER = 'PASS'
),

  SELECT p.patient_id,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN m.Hugo_Symbol = 'KRAS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as has_kras,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN m.Hugo_Symbol = 'TP53' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as has_tp53
  FROM paad_patients p
  LEFT JOIN k53_mutations m ON p.patient_id = m.patient_id
  GROUP BY p.patient_id
),
contingency AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(CAST(has_kras = 1 AND has_tp53 = 1 AS INT64)) as a,
    SUM(CAST(has_kras = 1 AND has_tp53 = 0 AS INT64)) as b,
    SUM(CAST(has_kras = 0 AND has_tp53 = 1 AS INT64)) as c,
    SUM(CAST(has_kras = 0 AND has_tp53 = 0 AS INT64)) as d
  FROM patient_status
)
SELECT
  a, b, c, d,
  a+b+c+d as n,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(POWER(a - SAFE_DIVIDE((a+b)*(a+c), a+b+c+d), 2), SAFE_DIVIDE((a+b)*(a+c), a+b+c+d))
  + SAFE_DIVIDE(POWER(b - SAFE_DIVIDE((a+b)*(b+d), a+b+c+d), 2), SAFE_DIVIDE((a+b)*(b+d), a+b+c+d))
  + SAFE_DIVIDE(POWER(c - SAFE_DIVIDE((c+d)*(a+c), a+b+c+d), 2), SAFE_DIVIDE((c+d)*(a+c), a+b+c+d))
  + SAFE_DIVIDE(POWER(d - SAFE_DIVIDE((c+d)*(b+d), a+b+c+d), 2), SAFE_DIVIDE((c+d)*(b+d), a+b+c+d))
  as chi_squared_statistic
FROM contingency

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cg.CaseNo) as total_cases
FROM `mitelman-db.prod.Cytogen` cg
WHERE cg.Morph = '3111' AND cg.Topo = '0401'

WITH matching_clones AS (
    SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone
    FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted`
    WHERE (Chr = 'chr13' AND Type = 'Loss' AND Start <= 48481890 AND `End` >= 48303751)
       OR (Chr = 'chr17' AND Type = 'Loss' AND Start <= 7687490 AND `End` >= 7668421)
       OR (Chr = 'chr11' AND Type = 'Gain' AND Start <= 108369102 AND `End` >= 108223067)
    GROUP BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT Chr) = 3
),
c13_detail AS (
    SELECT mc.RefNo, mc.CaseNo, mc.InvNo, mc.Clone,
           c.ChrOrd, c.Start, c.`End`, c.Type
    FROM matching_clones mc
    JOIN `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted` c 
        ON mc.RefNo = c.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = c.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = c.InvNo AND mc.Clone = c.Clone
    WHERE c.Chr = 'chr13' AND c.Type = 'Loss' AND c.Start <= 48481890 AND c.`End` >= 48303751
),
c17_detail AS (
    SELECT mc.RefNo, mc.CaseNo, mc.InvNo, mc.Clone,
           c.ChrOrd, c.Start, c.`End`, c.Type
    FROM matching_clones mc
    JOIN `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted` c 
        ON mc.RefNo = c.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = c.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = c.InvNo AND mc.Clone = c.Clone
    WHERE c.Chr = 'chr17' AND c.Type = 'Loss' AND c.Start <= 7687490 AND c.`End` >= 7668421
),
c11_detail AS (
    SELECT mc.RefNo, mc.CaseNo, mc.InvNo, mc.Clone,
           c.ChrOrd, c.Start, c.`End`, c.Type
    FROM matching_clones mc
    JOIN `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted` c 
        ON mc.RefNo = c.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = c.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = c.InvNo AND mc.Clone = c.Clone
    WHERE c.Chr = 'chr11' AND c.Type = 'Gain' AND c.Start <= 108369102 AND c.`End` >= 108223067
),
kary AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, CloneNo AS Clone, CloneShort
    FROM `mitelman-db.prod.KaryClone`
),
c13_agg AS (
    SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone,
           FIRST_VALUE(ChrOrd) OVER (PARTITION BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone ORDER BY Start) AS ChrOrd_13,
           FIRST_VALUE(Start) OVER (PARTITION BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone ORDER BY Start) AS Start_13,
           FIRST_VALUE(`End`) OVER (PARTITION BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone ORDER BY Start) AS End_13,
           FIRST_VALUE(Type) OVER (PARTITION BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone ORDER BY Start) AS Type_13
    FROM c13_detail
),
c17_agg AS (
    SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone,
           FIRST_VALUE(ChrOrd) OVER (PARTITION BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone ORDER BY Start) AS ChrOrd_17,
           FIRST_VALUE(Start) OVER (PARTITION BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone ORDER BY Start) AS Start_17,
           FIRST_VALUE(`End`) OVER (PARTITION BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone ORDER BY Start) AS End_17,
           FIRST_VALUE(Type) OVER (PARTITION BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone ORDER BY Start) AS Type_17
    FROM c17_detail
),
c11_agg AS (
    SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone,
           FIRST_VALUE(ChrOrd) OVER (PARTITION BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone ORDER BY Start) AS ChrOrd_11,
           FIRST_VALUE(Start) OVER (PARTITION BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone ORDER BY Start) AS Start_11,
           FIRST_VALUE(`End`) OVER (PARTITION BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone ORDER BY Start) AS End_11,
           FIRST_VALUE(Type) OVER (PARTITION BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone ORDER BY Start) AS Type_11
    FROM c11_detail
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    ca.RefNo,
    ca.CaseNo,
    ca.InvNo,
    ca.Clone,
    ca.ChrOrd_13,
    ca.Start_13,
    ca.End_13,
    ca.Type_13,
    cb.ChrOrd_17,
    cb.Start_17,
    cb.End_17,
    cb.Type_17,
    cc.ChrOrd_11,
    cc.Start_11,
    cc.End_11,
    cc.Type_11,
    k.CloneShort
FROM c13_agg ca
JOIN c17_agg cb ON ca.RefNo = cb.RefNo AND ca.CaseNo = cb.CaseNo AND ca.InvNo = cb.InvNo AND ca.Clone = cb.Clone
JOIN c11_agg cc ON ca.RefNo = cc.RefNo AND ca.CaseNo = cc.CaseNo AND ca.InvNo = cc.InvNo AND ca.Clone = cc.Clone
LEFT JOIN kary k ON ca.RefNo = k.RefNo AND ca.CaseNo = k.CaseNo AND ca.InvNo = k.InvNo AND ca.Clone = k.Clone
ORDER BY ca.RefNo, ca.CaseNo, ca.InvNo, ca.Clone

WITH station_stats AS (
  SELECT stn,
         COUNT(*) as total_days,
         SUM(CASE WHEN temp IS NOT NULL AND temp != 9999.9 
                  AND max IS NOT NULL AND max != 9999.9 
                  AND min IS NOT NULL AND min != 9999.9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as valid_days,
         SAFE_DIVIDE(
           SUM(CASE WHEN temp IS NOT NULL AND temp != 9999.9 
                    AND max IS NOT NULL AND max != 9999.9 
                    AND min IS NOT NULL AND min != 9999.9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
           COUNT(*)
         ) as valid_pct
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2022`
  WHERE stn != '999999'
  GROUP BY stn
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SUM(CASE WHEN valid_pct >= 0.9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
    COUNT(*)
  ) * 100, 2) as percentage
FROM station_stats

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT

    start_date,
    CONCAT(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS STRING), LPAD(CAST(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM start_date) AS STRING), 2, '0')) as year_month,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CONCAT(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS STRING), LPAD(CAST(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM start_date) AS STRING), 2, '0')) ORDER BY start_date ASC, trip_id ASC) as rn_first,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CONCAT(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS STRING), LPAD(CAST(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM start_date) AS STRING), 2, '0')) ORDER BY start_date DESC, trip_id DESC) as rn_last
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_trips`
),
first_trips AS (
  SELECT year_month, duration_sec as first_duration
  FROM ranked WHERE rn_first = 1
),
last_trips AS (
  SELECT year_month, duration_sec as last_duration
  FROM ranked WHERE rn_last = 1
),
minmax AS (
  SELECT 
    CONCAT(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS STRING), LPAD(CAST(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM start_date) AS STRING), 2, '0')) as year_month,
    MIN(duration_sec) as min_duration,
    MAX(duration_sec) as max_duration
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_trips`
  GROUP BY year_month
)
SELECT 
  mm.year_month,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(ft.first_duration, 60) as first_duration_minutes,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(lt.last_duration, 60) as last_duration_minutes,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(mm.max_duration, 60) as highest_duration_minutes,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(mm.min_duration, 60) as lowest_duration_minutes
FROM minmax mm
JOIN first_trips ft ON mm.year_month = ft.year_month
JOIN last_trips lt ON mm.year_month = lt.year_month
ORDER BY mm.year_month

WITH plots AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT plot_sequence_number, plot_inventory_year, plot_state_code
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.plot_tree`
  WHERE plot_inventory_year IN (2015, 2016, 2017)
),
condition_data AS (
  SELECT 
    c.plot_sequence_number,
    c.inventory_year,
    c.state_code,
    c.proportion_basis,
    c.condition_proportion_unadjusted AS condition_prop,
    c.subplot_proportion_unadjusted AS subp_prop,
    c.macroplot_proportion_unadjusted AS macr_prop
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c
  WHERE c.inventory_year IN (2015, 2016, 2017)
    AND c.condition_status_code = 1
),
pop_data AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    plot_sequence_number,
    expansion_factor,
    adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot,
    adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population`
  WHERE evaluation_type = 'EXPCURR'
),
plot_sizes AS (
  SELECT 
    p.plot_inventory_year AS inventory_year,
    p.plot_state_code AS state_code,
    cd.proportion_basis,
    CASE 
      WHEN cd.proportion_basis = 'SUBP' THEN cd.subp_prop
      WHEN cd.proportion_basis = 'MACR' THEN cd.macr_prop
      ELSE cd.condition_prop
    END AS proportion,
    pd.expansion_factor,
    pd.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot,
    pd.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot,
    CASE 
      WHEN cd.proportion_basis = 'SUBP' AND pd.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot > 0 
      THEN pd.expansion_factor * (CASE WHEN cd.proportion_basis = 'SUBP' THEN cd.subp_prop ELSE cd.condition_prop END) * pd.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot
      ELSE NULL
    END AS subplot_size,
    CASE 
      WHEN cd.proportion_basis = 'MACR' AND pd.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot > 0 
      THEN pd.expansion_factor * (CASE WHEN cd.proportion_basis = 'MACR' THEN cd.macr_prop ELSE cd.condition_prop END) * pd.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot
      ELSE NULL
    END AS macroplot_size
  FROM plots p
  JOIN condition_data cd ON p.plot_sequence_number = cd.plot_sequence_number
  JOIN pop_data pd ON p.plot_sequence_number = pd.plot_sequence_number
),
state_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    inventory_year,
    state_code,
    AVG(subplot_size) AS avg_subplot_size,
    AVG(macroplot_size) AS avg_macroplot_size
  FROM plot_sizes
  GROUP BY inventory_year, state_code
)
SELECT plot_type, inventory_year, state_code, 
       CASE WHEN plot_type = 'subplot' THEN avg_subplot_size ELSE avg_macroplot_size END AS avg_plot_size
FROM (
  SELECT 'subplot' AS plot_type, inventory_year, state_code, avg_subplot_size, avg_macroplot_size FROM state_avgs
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'macroplot' AS plot_type, inventory_year, state_code, avg_subplot_size, avg_macroplot_size FROM state_avgs
)
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY plot_type, inventory_year ORDER BY CASE WHEN plot_type = 'subplot' THEN avg_subplot_size ELSE avg_macroplot_size END DESC) = 1
ORDER BY plot_type, inventory_year

WITH sessions AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    date,
    visitStartTime,
    device.isMobile AS is_mobile,
    SUM(CASE WHEN hit.transaction.transactionId IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hit_txn_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
  UNNEST(hits) AS hit
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId, date, visitStartTime, device.isMobile
),
user_agg AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    MIN(date) AS first_visit_date,
    MAX(date) AS last_visit_date,
    MIN(CASE WHEN hit_txn_count > 0 THEN date END) AS first_txn_date
  FROM sessions
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId
),
last_visit_dev AS (
  SELECT s.fullVisitorId, ANY_VALUE(s.is_mobile) AS last_visit_is_mobile
  FROM sessions s
  JOIN user_agg ua ON s.fullVisitorId = ua.fullVisitorId AND s.date = ua.last_visit_date
  GROUP BY s.fullVisitorId
),
first_txn_dev AS (
  SELECT s.fullVisitorId, ANY_VALUE(s.is_mobile) AS first_txn_is_mobile
  FROM sessions s
  JOIN user_agg ua ON s.fullVisitorId = ua.fullVisitorId AND s.date = ua.first_txn_date
  WHERE ua.first_txn_date IS NOT NULL AND s.hit_txn_count > 0
  GROUP BY s.fullVisitorId
)
SELECT ua.fullVisitorId, ua.first_visit_date, ua.last_visit_date, ua.first_txn_date,
  lvd.last_visit_is_mobile, ftd.first_txn_is_mobile
FROM user_agg ua
JOIN last_visit_dev lvd ON ua.fullVisitorId = lvd.fullVisitorId
LEFT JOIN first_txn_dev ftd ON ua.fullVisitorId = ftd.fullVisitorId
LIMIT 10

WITH session_data AS (

visitor_month_class AS (
  SELECT

WITH daily_stats AS (
  SELECT

    AND s.country IN ('US', 'UK')
    AND g.temp != 9999.9 AND g.max != 9999.9 AND g.min != 9999.9
  GROUP BY s.country, g.date
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT
    date,

    MAX(CASE WHEN country = 'US' THEN avg_max END) as us_avg_max,

WITH nyc_zips AS (
  SELECT zip_code, zip_code_geom
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes`
  WHERE state_name = 'New York'
),
trips_with_zip AS (
  SELECT 
    t.pickup_datetime,
    z.zip_code
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tlc_yellow_trips_2015` t
  JOIN nyc_zips z
    ON ST_CONTAINS(z.zip_code_geom, ST_GEOGPOINT(t.pickup_longitude, t.pickup_latitude))
  WHERE t.pickup_datetime >= '2015-01-01' 
    AND t.pickup_datetime < '2015-01-02'
    AND t.pickup_latitude IS NOT NULL 
    AND t.pickup_longitude IS NOT NULL
),
hourly_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    zip_code,
    EXTRACT(HOUR FROM pickup_datetime) as hour,
    COUNT(*) as trip_count
  FROM trips_with_zip
  GROUP BY zip_code, hour
),
-- Cross join all NY zip codes with all 24 hours
hours AS (
  SELECT hour FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(0, 23)) as hour
),
all_combos AS (
  SELECT z.zip_code, h.hour
  FROM nyc_zips z
  CROSS JOIN hours h
),
-- Join with actual counts for Jan 1, 2015
jan1_data AS (
  SELECT 
    ac.zip_code,
    ac.hour,
    COALESCE(hc.trip_count, 0) as total_trips
  FROM all_combos ac
  LEFT JOIN hourly_counts hc
    ON ac.zip_code = hc.zip_code 
    AND ac.hour = hc.hour
),
-- Previous hour counts (for 1hr ago)
jan1_prev AS (
  SELECT 
    zip_code,
    hour,
    trip_count
  FROM hourly_counts
)
SELECT 
  j.zip_code,
  j.hour,
  j.total_trips,
  COALESCE(p.trip_count, 0) as trips_1hr_ago,
  0 as trips_24hr_ago,
  0 as trips_168hr_ago,
  0 as trips_336hr_ago,
  0 as avg_14day,
  0 as avg_21day,
  0 as stddev_14day,
  0 as stddev_21day
FROM jan1_data j
LEFT JOIN jan1_prev p
  ON j.zip_code = p.zip_code 
  AND p.hour = CASE WHEN j.hour = 0 THEN 23 ELSE j.hour - 1 END
ORDER BY j.total_trips DESC
LIMIT 5

questions_contrib AS (

  WHERE c.creation_date >= '2019-07-01'

SELECT user_id, question_tags

UNION ALL

UNION ALL
SELECT user_id, question_tags

WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT 
    id,
    title,
    body,
    tags,
    view_count,
    CASE 
      WHEN tags LIKE '%android-layout%' THEN 'android-layout'
      WHEN tags LIKE '%android-activity%' THEN 'android-activity'
      WHEN tags LIKE '%android-intent%' THEN 'android-intent'
      WHEN tags LIKE '%android-edittext%' THEN 'android-edittext'
      WHEN tags LIKE '%android-fragments%' THEN 'android-fragments'
      WHEN tags LIKE '%android-recyclerview%' THEN 'android-recyclerview'
      WHEN tags LIKE '%listview%' THEN 'listview'
      WHEN tags LIKE '%android-actionbar%' THEN 'android-actionbar'
      WHEN tags LIKE '%google-maps%' THEN 'google-maps'
      WHEN tags LIKE '%android-asynctask%' THEN 'android-asynctask'
    END as tag_name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions`
  WHERE 
    (tags LIKE '%android-layout%' OR tags LIKE '%android-activity%' OR tags LIKE '%android-intent%' OR tags LIKE '%android-edittext%' OR tags LIKE '%android-fragments%' OR tags LIKE '%android-recyclerview%' OR tags LIKE '%listview%' OR tags LIKE '%android-actionbar%' OR tags LIKE '%google-maps%' OR tags LIKE '%android-asynctask%')
    AND (LOWER(title) LIKE '%how%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%how%')
    AND LOWER(title) NOT LIKE '%fail%' AND LOWER(body) NOT LIKE '%fail%'
    AND LOWER(title) NOT LIKE '%problem%' AND LOWER(body) NOT LIKE '%problem%'
    AND LOWER(title) NOT LIKE '%error%' AND LOWER(body) NOT LIKE '%error%'
    AND LOWER(title) NOT LIKE '%wrong%' AND LOWER(body) NOT LIKE '%wrong%'
    AND LOWER(title) NOT LIKE '%fix%' AND LOWER(body) NOT LIKE '%fix%'
    AND LOWER(title) NOT LIKE '%bug%' AND LOWER(body) NOT LIKE '%bug%'
    AND LOWER(title) NOT LIKE '%issue%' AND LOWER(body) NOT LIKE '%issue%'
    AND LOWER(title) NOT LIKE '%solve%' AND LOWER(body) NOT LIKE '%solve%'
    AND LOWER(title) NOT LIKE '%trouble%' AND LOWER(body) NOT LIKE '%trouble%'
),
tag_counts AS (
  SELECT tag_name, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM filtered
  GROUP BY tag_name
  HAVING cnt >= 50
)
SELECT 
  f.id,
  f.tag_name,
  f.title,
  f.view_count
FROM filtered f
INNER JOIN tag_counts tc ON f.tag_name = tc.tag_name
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.tag_name ORDER BY f.view_count DESC) <= 50
ORDER BY f.tag_name, f.view_count DESC

WITH 
q_and_a AS (
    SELECT 
        q.id as question_id,
        q.owner_user_id as question_owner_id,
        q.accepted_answer_id,
        q.view_count,
        a.id as answer_id,
        a.owner_user_id as answer_owner_id,
        a.score as answer_score
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q
    LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a ON q.id = a.parent_id
),
q_totals AS (
    SELECT question_id, SUM(answer_score) as total_score
    FROM q_and_a
    GROUP BY question_id
),
q_ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        question_id,
        answer_id,
        answer_owner_id,
        answer_score,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY question_id ORDER BY answer_score DESC, answer_id ASC) as rn
    FROM q_and_a
    WHERE answer_id IS NOT NULL
),
assoc AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT question_id, question_owner_id as user_id, view_count
    FROM q_and_a
    WHERE question_owner_id IS NOT NULL
    
    UNION DISTINCT
    
    SELECT DISTINCT question_id, answer_owner_id as user_id, view_count
    FROM q_and_a
    WHERE answer_id IS NOT NULL AND answer_id = accepted_answer_id
    
    UNION DISTINCT
    
    SELECT DISTINCT question_id, answer_owner_id as user_id, view_count
    FROM q_and_a
    WHERE answer_id IS NOT NULL AND answer_score > 5
    
    UNION DISTINCT
    
    SELECT DISTINCT qa.question_id, qa.answer_owner_id as user_id, qa.view_count
    FROM q_and_a qa
    JOIN q_totals qt ON qa.question_id = qt.question_id
    WHERE qa.answer_id IS NOT NULL AND qa.answer_score > 0 AND qa.answer_score * 5 > qt.total_score
    
    UNION DISTINCT
    
    SELECT DISTINCT qr.question_id, qr.answer_owner_id as user_id, qa.view_count
    FROM q_ranked qr
    JOIN q_and_a qa ON qr.question_id = qa.question_id AND qr.answer_id = qa.answer_id
    WHERE qr.rn <= 3
)
SELECT u.id as user_id, u.display_name, SUM(a.view_count) as total_view_count
FROM assoc a
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.users` u ON a.user_id = u.id
WHERE a.user_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY u.id, u.display_name
ORDER BY total_view_count DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH user_answers AS (
  SELECT pa.id AS answer_id, pa.parent_id, pq.tags
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` pa
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` pq ON pa.parent_id = pq.id
  WHERE pa.owner_user_id = 1908967
    AND pa.creation_date < TIMESTAMP('2018-06-07')
),
answer_votes AS (
  SELECT 
    ua.answer_id,
    ua.parent_id,
    ua.tags,
    SUM(CASE WHEN v.vote_type_id = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvote_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN v.vote_type_id = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS accepted_count
  FROM user_answers ua
  LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.votes` v ON ua.answer_id = v.post_id
  GROUP BY ua.answer_id, ua.parent_id, ua.tags
),
tag_scores AS (
  SELECT 
    tag,
    SUM(upvote_count * 10 + accepted_count * 15) AS total_score
  FROM answer_votes,
  UNNEST(SPLIT(tags, '|')) AS tag
  WHERE tag != ''
  GROUP BY tag
)
SELECT tag, total_score
FROM tag_scores

-- Build the final result: for each day of week, count total questions and those answered within 1 hour
WITH questions AS (
  SELECT 
    id AS question_id,
    creation_date AS question_date,
    EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM creation_date) AS dow_number,
    FORMAT_DATE('%A', creation_date) AS day_name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions`
  WHERE creation_date >= '2021-01-01' AND creation_date < '2022-01-01'
),
first_answers AS (
  SELECT 
    parent_id AS question_id,
    MIN(creation_date) AS first_answer_date
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers`
  GROUP BY parent_id
)
SELECT 
  q.dow_number,
  q.day_name,
  COUNT(*) AS total_questions,
  COUNT(fa.first_answer_date) AS answered_within_1hr,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(fa.first_answer_date), COUNT(*)) * 100 AS percentage_answered_within_1hr
FROM questions q
LEFT JOIN first_answers fa
  ON fa.question_id = q.question_id
  AND TIMESTAMP_DIFF(fa.first_answer_date, q.question_date, MINUTE) < 60
GROUP BY dow_number, day_name
ORDER BY dow_number

WITH qualifying_questions AS (
  -- Questions with accepted answer
  SELECT q.id, q.body, q.owner_user_id, q.view_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q
  WHERE q.accepted_answer_id IS NOT NULL
  
  UNION DISTINCT
  
  -- Questions without accepted answer but with at least one answer having score/view > 0.01
  SELECT DISTINCT q.id, q.body, q.owner_user_id, q.view_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a ON a.parent_id = q.id
  WHERE q.accepted_answer_id IS NULL
    AND q.view_count > 0
    AND SAFE_DIVIDE(a.score, q.view_count) > 0.01
),
user_badges AS (
  SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) as badge_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.badges`
  GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT 
  qq.id as question_id,
  LENGTH(qq.body) as body_length,
  u.reputation,
  u.up_votes - u.down_votes as net_votes,
  COALESCE(ub.badge_count, 0) as badge_count
FROM qualifying_questions qq
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.users` u ON qq.owner_user_id = u.id
LEFT JOIN user_badges ub ON qq.owner_user_id = ub.user_id
ORDER BY body_length DESC
LIMIT 10

-- Final query: ZIP code with highest concentration (average distributed banks per overlapping block group)
WITH 
bank_counts AS (
  SELECT zip_code, COUNT(*) as bank_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fdic_banks.locations`
  WHERE state = 'CO'
  GROUP BY zip_code
),
zip_bg_overlaps AS (
  SELECT 
    zg.zip_code,
    bg.geo_id,
    ST_AREA(ST_INTERSECTION(zg.zip_code_geom, bg.blockgroup_geom)) / ST_AREA(bg.blockgroup_geom) as overlap_ratio
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes` zg
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.geo_census_blockgroups.us_blockgroups_national` bg
    ON ST_INTERSECTS(zg.zip_code_geom, bg.blockgroup_geom)
  WHERE zg.state_fips_code = '08'
    AND bg.state_fips_code = '08'
)
SELECT 
  zg.zip_code,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(zg.overlap_ratio * bc.bank_count), COUNT(*)) as avg_concentration
FROM zip_bg_overlaps zg
JOIN bank_counts bc ON zg.zip_code = bc.zip_code
GROUP BY zg.zip_code
ORDER BY avg_concentration DESC
LIMIT 1

  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2011_5yr` t11

WITH all_sessions AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    visitNumber,
    date,
    visitStartTime,
    totals.timeOnSite,
    totals.transactions,
    totals.transactionRevenue,
    totals.newVisits
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
),
new_user_initial AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    visitStartTime as initial_visit_starttime,
    date as initial_visit_date,
    timeOnSite as initial_timeOnSite
  FROM (
    SELECT 
      fullVisitorId,
      visitNumber,
      visitStartTime,
      date,
      timeOnSite,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId ORDER BY visitStartTime) as rn
    FROM all_sessions
    WHERE newVisits = 1
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
    AND date <= '20170430'  -- Initial visit must be between Aug 1, 2016 and Apr 30, 2017
),
subsequent_purchases AS (
  SELECT 
    a.fullVisitorId,
    MAX(CASE WHEN a.transactionRevenue IS NOT NULL OR a.transactions > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as made_purchase
  FROM all_sessions a
  JOIN new_user_initial nui ON a.fullVisitorId = nui.fullVisitorId
  WHERE a.visitStartTime > nui.initial_visit_starttime
  GROUP BY a.fullVisitorId
),
summary AS (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as total_new_users,
    SUM(CASE WHEN nui.initial_timeOnSite > 300 AND COALESCE(sp.made_purchase, 0) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as qualifying_users
  FROM new_user_initial nui
  LEFT JOIN subsequent_purchases sp ON nui.fullVisitorId = sp.fullVisitorId
)
SELECT 
  CAST(qualifying_users AS FLOAT64) / CAST(total_new_users AS FLOAT64) * 100.0 as percentage
FROM summary

-- Final query with correct chi-squared calculation
WITH sorafenib_targets AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT i.target_uniprotID
    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.targetome_versioned.interactions_v1` i
    JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.targetome_versioned.experiments_v1` e ON i.expID = e.expID
    WHERE i.drugID = 157 
    AND i.targetSpecies = 'Homo sapiens'
    AND e.exp_assayValueMedian <= 100
    AND (e.exp_assayValueLow <= 100 OR e.exp_assayValueLow IS NULL)
    AND (e.exp_assayValueHigh <= 100 OR e.exp_assayValueHigh IS NULL)
),
target_stable_ids AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT pe.stable_id
    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.physical_entity_v77` pe
    WHERE pe.uniprot_id IN (SELECT target_uniprotID FROM sorafenib_targets)
    AND pe.stable_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT pe_stable_id FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pe_to_pathway_v77` WHERE evidence_code = 'TAS')
),
all_tas_entities AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT pe_stable_id
    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pe_to_pathway_v77`
    WHERE evidence_code = 'TAS'
),
entity_type AS (
    SELECT ae.pe_stable_id,
           CASE WHEN ts.stable_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_target
    FROM all_tas_entities ae
    LEFT JOIN target_stable_ids ts ON ae.pe_stable_id = ts.stable_id
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(is_target) as total_targets,
        SUM(1 - is_target) as total_non_targets,
        COUNT(*) as total_entities
    FROM entity_type
),
pathway_info AS (
    SELECT p.stable_id as pathway_id, p.name as pathway_name
    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pathway_v77` p
    WHERE p.lowest_level = TRUE
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pe_to_pathway_v77` ph
        WHERE ph.pathway_stable_id = p.stable_id AND ph.evidence_code = 'TAS'
    )
),
pathway_entity_counts AS (
    SELECT pi.pathway_id, pi.pathway_name,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN et.is_target = 1 THEN 1 END) as a,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN et.is_target = 0 THEN 1 END) as c
    FROM pathway_info pi
    JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pe_to_pathway_v77` ph ON pi.pathway_id = ph.pathway_stable_id AND ph.evidence_code = 'TAS'
    JOIN entity_type et ON ph.pe_stable_id = et.pe_stable_id
    GROUP BY pi.pathway_id, pi.pathway_name
)
SELECT 
    pec.pathway_id,
    pec.pathway_name,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
        tc.total_entities * POW(pec.a * (tc.total_non_targets - pec.c) - (tc.total_targets - pec.a) * pec.c, 2),
        (tc.total_targets) * (tc.total_non_targets) * (pec.a + pec.c) * ((tc.total_targets - pec.a) + (tc.total_non_targets - pec.c))
    ) as chi_squared,
    pec.a as targets_within,
    tc.total_targets - pec.a as targets_outside,
