WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    a.activity_id, 
    a.assay_id, 
    a.doc_id, 
    a.molregno, 
    a.standard_relation, 
    SAFE_CAST(a.standard_value AS FLOAT64) AS standard_value_f,
    a.standard_type, 
    SAFE_CAST(a.pchembl_value AS FLOAT64) AS pchembl_value_f,
    a.potential_duplicate,
    SAFE_CAST(cp.heavy_atoms AS INT64) AS heavy_atoms,
    cs.canonical_smiles
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.activities_29` a
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.compound_properties_29` cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.compound_structures_29` cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
  WHERE cp.heavy_atoms IS NOT NULL 
    AND SAFE_CAST(cp.heavy_atoms AS INT64) BETWEEN 10 AND 15
    AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
    AND SAFE_CAST(a.pchembl_value AS FLOAT64) > 10
    AND a.potential_duplicate = '0'
),
mol_assay_counts AS (
  SELECT molregno, assay_id, standard_type, COUNT(*) AS act_count
  FROM base
  GROUP BY molregno, assay_id, standard_type
),
valid AS (
  SELECT b.*
  FROM base b
  JOIN mol_assay_counts mac ON b.molregno = mac.molregno 
    AND b.assay_id = mac.assay_id 
    AND b.standard_type = mac.standard_type
  WHERE mac.act_count < 5
),
molecules_per_group AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molregno, assay_id, standard_type
  FROM valid
),
pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    m1.molregno AS molregno_1,
    m2.molregno AS molregno_2,
    m1.assay_id,
    m1.standard_type
  FROM molecules_per_group m1
  JOIN molecules_per_group m2 
    ON m1.assay_id = m2.assay_id 
    AND m1.standard_type = m2.standard_type
    AND m1.molregno < m2.molregno
),
pair_activities AS (
  SELECT 
    p.molregno_1,
    p.molregno_2,
    p.assay_id,
    p.standard_type,
    v1.activity_id AS activity_id_1,
    v1.canonical_smiles AS smiles_1,
    v1.standard_value_f AS std_val_1,
    v1.standard_relation AS rel_1,
    v1.doc_id AS doc_id_1,
    v1.heavy_atoms AS heavy_atoms_1,
    v2.activity_id AS activity_id_2,
    v2.canonical_smiles AS smiles_2,
    v2.standard_value_f AS std_val_2,
    v2.standard_relation AS rel_2,
    v2.doc_id AS doc_id_2,
    v2.heavy_atoms AS heavy_atoms_2
  FROM pairs p
  JOIN valid v1 ON p.molregno_1 = v1.molregno 
    AND p.assay_id = v1.assay_id 
    AND p.standard_type = v1.standard_type
  JOIN valid v2 ON p.molregno_2 = v2.molregno 
    AND p.assay_id = v2.assay_id 
    AND p.standard_type = v2.standard_type
),
docs_info AS (
  SELECT doc_id, journal, SAFE_CAST(year AS INT64) AS year_val, SAFE_CAST(first_page AS INT64) AS first_page
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.docs_29`
),
pair_docs AS (
  SELECT 
    pa.*,
    d1.journal AS journal_1, d1.year_val AS year_1, d1.first_page AS fp_1,
    d2.journal AS journal_2, d2.year_val AS year_2, d2.first_page AS fp_2
  FROM pair_activities pa
  LEFT JOIN docs_info d1 ON pa.doc_id_1 = d1.doc_id
  LEFT JOIN docs_info d2 ON pa.doc_id_2 = d2.doc_id
),
doc_ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    did,
    dj,
    dy,
    dfp,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY dj, dy) > 1 
      THEN (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dj, dy ORDER BY dfp) - 1) * 1.0 / (COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY dj, dy) - 1)
      ELSE 0 
    END AS percent_rank
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT doc_id_1 AS did, journal_1 AS dj, year_1 AS dy, fp_1 AS dfp
    FROM pair_docs
    UNION DISTINCT
    SELECT DISTINCT doc_id_2, journal_2, year_2, fp_2
    FROM pair_docs
  )
),
pair_with_dates AS (
  SELECT 
    pd.*,
    dr1.percent_rank AS pr_1,
    dr2.percent_rank AS pr_2
  FROM pair_docs pd
  LEFT JOIN doc_ranked dr1 ON pd.doc_id_1 = dr1.did
  LEFT JOIN doc_ranked dr2 ON pd.doc_id_2 = dr2.did
),
pair_full_dates AS (
  SELECT 
    pw.*,
    COALESCE(CAST(year_1 AS STRING), '1970') AS pub_year_1,
    COALESCE(CAST(FLOOR(COALESCE(pr_1, 0) * 11) + 1 AS STRING), '1') AS pub_month_1,
    COALESCE(CAST(MOD(CAST(FLOOR(COALESCE(pr_1, 0) * 308) AS INT64), 28) + 1 AS STRING), '1') AS pub_day_1,
    COALESCE(CAST(year_2 AS STRING), '1970') AS pub_year_2,
    COALESCE(CAST(FLOOR(COALESCE(pr_2, 0) * 11) + 1 AS STRING), '1') AS pub_month_2,
    COALESCE(CAST(MOD(CAST(FLOOR(COALESCE(pr_2, 0) * 308) AS INT64), 28) + 1 AS STRING), '1') AS pub_day_2,
    COALESCE(CAST(year_1 AS STRING), '1970') || '-' || 
      LPAD(COALESCE(CAST(FLOOR(COALESCE(pr_1, 0) * 11) + 1 AS STRING), '1'), 2, '0') || '-' ||
      LPAD(COALESCE(CAST(MOD(CAST(FLOOR(COALESCE(pr_1, 0) * 308) AS INT64), 28) + 1 AS STRING), '1'), 2, '0') AS date_str_1,
    COALESCE(CAST(year_2 AS STRING), '1970') || '-' || 
      LPAD(COALESCE(CAST(FLOOR(COALESCE(pr_2, 0) * 11) + 1 AS STRING), '1'), 2, '0') || '-' ||
      LPAD(COALESCE(CAST(MOD(CAST(FLOOR(COALESCE(pr_2, 0) * 308) AS INT64), 28) + 1 AS STRING), '1'), 2, '0') AS date_str_2
  FROM pair_with_dates pw
),
final_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    molregno_1,
    molregno_2,
    assay_id,
    standard_type,
    activity_id_1,
    activity_id_2,
    smiles_1,
    smiles_2,
    std_val_1,
    std_val_2,
    rel_1,
    rel_2,
    heavy_atoms_1,
    heavy_atoms_2,
    doc_id_1,
    doc_id_2,
    GREATEST(heavy_atoms_1, heavy_atoms_2) AS max_heavy_atoms,
    GREATEST(doc_id_1, doc_id_2) AS highest_doc_id,
    pub_year_1, pub_month_1, pub_day_1,
    pub_year_2, pub_month_2, pub_day_2,
    date_str_1, date_str_2,
    CASE WHEN date_str_1 >= date_str_2 THEN date_str_1 ELSE date_str_2 END AS latest_pub_date,
    CASE WHEN date_str_1 >= date_str_2 THEN pub_year_1 ELSE pub_year_2 END AS latest_pub_year,
    CASE WHEN date_str_1 >= date_str_2 THEN pub_month_1 ELSE pub_month_2 END AS latest_pub_month,
    CASE WHEN date_str_1 >= date_str_2 THEN pub_day_1 ELSE pub_day_2 END AS latest_pub_day,
    CASE 
      WHEN std_val_1 > std_val_2 THEN 'decrease'
      WHEN std_val_1 < std_val_2 THEN 'increase'
      ELSE 'no-change'
    END AS std_change,
    TO_HEX(MD5(TO_JSON_STRING(STRUCT(activity_id_1, activity_id_2)))) AS activity_pair_uuid,
    TO_HEX(MD5(TO_JSON_STRING(STRUCT(smiles_1, smiles_2)))) AS smiles_pair_uuid
  FROM pair_full_dates
)
SELECT 
  molregno_1,
  molregno_2,
  assay_id,
  standard_type,
  activity_id_1,
  activity_id_2,
  smiles_1,
  smiles_2,
  max_heavy_atoms,
  latest_pub_year,
  latest_pub_month,
  latest_pub_day,
  latest_pub_date,
  highest_doc_id,
  std_change,
  activity_pair_uuid,
  smiles_pair_uuid
FROM final_pairs
ORDER BY molregno_1, molregno_2, assay_id, standard_type

      CASE WHEN event_description LIKE '%free throw 1%' THEN 1 
           WHEN event_description LIKE '%free throw 2%' THEN 2 
           WHEN event_description LIKE '%free throw 3%' THEN 3 
           ELSE 0 END) as rn
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_pbp_sr`

  s1.team_name AS scoring_team,

  SAFE_CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN s2.team_name = 'Wildcats' THEN s2.points_scored ELSE 0 END) AS INT64) AS wildcats_score,

WITH user_first AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    MIN(event_date) as first_session_date
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE event_name = 'session_start'
    AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180709' AND '20181002'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
),
user_touch AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    user_first_touch_timestamp
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180709' AND '20181002'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id, user_first_touch_timestamp
),
new_users AS (
  SELECT 
    uf.user_pseudo_id,
    uf.first_session_date
  FROM user_first uf
  JOIN user_touch ut ON uf.user_pseudo_id = ut.user_pseudo_id
  WHERE FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', DATE(TIMESTAMP_MICROS(ut.user_first_touch_timestamp))) = uf.first_session_date
),
user_cohort AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    DATE_SUB(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', first_session_date), INTERVAL (EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', first_session_date)) - 2) DAY) as cohort_start
  FROM new_users
  WHERE DATE_SUB(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', first_session_date), INTERVAL (EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', first_session_date)) - 2) DAY) 
    BETWEEN '2018-07-09' AND '2018-09-17'
),
user_sessions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    user_pseudo_id,
    event_date
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE event_name = 'session_start'
    AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180709' AND '20181002'
)
SELECT 
  FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', uc.cohort_start) as cohort_date,
  COUNT(DISTINCT uc.user_pseudo_id) as total_users,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
    WHEN us.event_date = FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', DATE_ADD(CAST(uc.cohort_start AS DATE), INTERVAL 14 DAY))
    THEN uc.user_pseudo_id 
  END) as retained_users,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
      WHEN us.event_date = FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', DATE_ADD(CAST(uc.cohort_start AS DATE), INTERVAL 14 DAY))
      THEN uc.user_pseudo_id 
    END),
    COUNT(DISTINCT uc.user_pseudo_id)
  ), 4) as retention_rate
FROM user_cohort uc
LEFT JOIN user_sessions us ON uc.user_pseudo_id = us.user_pseudo_id
GROUP BY uc.cohort_start
ORDER BY uc.cohort_start

  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(event_params) as event_params
  WHERE event_name = 'page_view'

classified AS (
  SELECT 
    page_location,
    ARRAY_LENGTH(SPLIT(page_location, '/')) as num_segments,
    IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(SPLIT(page_location, '/')) >= 5, SPLIT(page_location, '/')[OFFSET(3)], NULL) as seg4,
    IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(SPLIT(page_location, '/')) >= 5, SPLIT(page_location, '/')[OFFSET(4)], NULL) as seg5,
    IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(SPLIT(page_location, '/')) >= 5, SPLIT(page_location, '/')[OFFSET(ARRAY_LENGTH(SPLIT(page_location, '/')) - 1)], NULL) as last_seg
  FROM page_views
),
categories AS (
  SELECT 'accessories' as cat UNION ALL
  SELECT 'apparel' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'brands' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'campus collection' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'drinkware' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'electronics' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'google redesign' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'lifestyle' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'nest' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'new 2015 logo' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'notebooks journals' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'office' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'shop by brand' UNION ALL

  SELECT 'stationery' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'wearables'
),
with_type AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE 
      WHEN num_segments >= 5 
        AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM categories c 
          WHERE REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(REPLACE(seg4, '+', ' ')), c.cat) 
            OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(REPLACE(seg5, '+', ' ')), c.cat))
        AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(last_seg, r'\+')
      THEN 'PDP'
      WHEN num_segments >= 5 
        AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM categories c 
          WHERE REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(REPLACE(seg4, '+', ' ')), c.cat) 
            OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(REPLACE(seg5, '+', ' ')), c.cat))

WITH sessions AS (
  SELECT 
    DISTINCT (SELECT value.int_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'ga_session_id') AS session_id,
    COALESCE(traffic_source.medium, '') AS medium,
    COALESCE(traffic_source.source, '') AS source,
    COALESCE(traffic_source.name, '') AS name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201201' AND '20201231'
  AND (SELECT value.int_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'ga_session_id') IS NOT NULL
),
channelized AS (
  SELECT 
    session_id,
    CASE
      WHEN source = '(direct)' AND medium IN ('(not set)', '(none)') THEN 'Direct'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('baidu','bing','duckduckgo','ecosia','google','yahoo','yandex') 
           AND (LOWER(medium) LIKE '%cp%' OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%ppc%' OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%paid%') THEN 'Paid Search'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('badoo','facebook','fb','instagram','linkedin','pinterest','tiktok','twitter','whatsapp') 
           AND (LOWER(medium) LIKE '%cp%' OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%ppc%' OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%paid%') THEN 'Paid Social'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('dailymotion','disneyplus','netflix','youtube','vimeo','twitch') 
           AND (LOWER(medium) LIKE '%cp%' OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%ppc%' OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%paid%') THEN 'Paid Video'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('alibaba','amazon','google shopping','shopify','etsy','ebay','stripe','walmart')) 
           AND (LOWER(medium) LIKE '%cp%' OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%ppc%' OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%paid%') THEN 'Paid Shopping'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) IN ('display','banner','expandable','interstitial','cpm') THEN 'Display'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'affiliate' THEN 'Affiliates'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'audio' THEN 'Audio'
      WHEN source = 'sms' OR LOWER(medium) = 'sms' THEN 'SMS'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) LIKE '%push' OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%mobile%' OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%notification%' THEN 'Mobile Push Notifications'
      WHEN name LIKE '%cross-network%' THEN 'Cross-network'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('email','e-mail','e_mail','e mail') OR LOWER(medium) IN ('email','e-mail','e_mail','e mail') THEN 'Email'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('badoo','facebook','fb','instagram','linkedin','pinterest','tiktok','twitter','whatsapp')) 
           OR LOWER(medium) IN ('social','social-network','social-media','sm','social network','social media') THEN 'Organic Social'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('dailymotion','disneyplus','netflix','youtube','vimeo','twitch')) 
           OR LOWER(medium) LIKE '%video%' THEN 'Organic Video'
      WHEN (LOWER(source) IN ('alibaba','amazon','google shopping','shopify','etsy','ebay','stripe','walmart')) 
           OR name LIKE '%shop%' OR name LIKE '%shopping%' THEN 'Organic Shopping'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'referral' THEN 'Referral'
      WHEN LOWER(source) IN ('baidu','bing','duckduckgo','ecosia','google','yahoo','yandex') 
           OR LOWER(medium) = 'organic' THEN 'Organic Search'
      ELSE 'Unassigned'
    END AS channel
  FROM sessions
)
SELECT channel, COUNT(*) as session_count
FROM channelized
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY session_count DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH event_session_params AS (

    MAX(CASE WHEN ep.key = 'medium' THEN ep.value.string_value END) AS medium,

session_traffic AS (

),
session_channel AS (
  SELECT 
    session_id,
    CASE
      WHEN source = '(direct)' AND medium IN ('(not set)', '(none)') THEN 'Direct'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(campaign, 'cross-network') THEN 'Cross-network'
      WHEN (REGEXP_CONTAINS(source, 'alibaba|amazon|google shopping|shopify|etsy|ebay|stripe|walmart') 
            OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(campaign, r'^(.*(([^a-df-z]|^)shop|shopping).*)$'))
        AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'^(.*cp.*|ppc|retargeting|paid.*)$') THEN 'Paid Shopping'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(source, 'baidu|bing|duckduckgo|ecosia|google|yahoo|yandex')
        AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'^(.*cp.*|ppc|paid.*)$') THEN 'Paid Search'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(source, r'badoo|facebook|fb|instagram|linkedin|pinterest|tiktok|twitter|whatsapp')
        AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'^(.*cp.*|ppc|retargeting|paid.*)$') THEN 'Paid Social'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(source, r'dailymotion|disneyplus|netflix|youtube|vimeo|twitch')
        AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'^(.*cp.*|ppc|retargeting|paid.*)$') THEN 'Paid Video'
      WHEN medium IN ('display', 'banner', 'expandable', 'interstitial', 'cpm') THEN 'Display'
      WHEN (REGEXP_CONTAINS(source, 'alibaba|amazon|google shopping|shopify|etsy|ebay|stripe|walmart') 
            OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(campaign, r'^(.*(([^a-df-z]|^)shop|shopping).*)$'))
        AND NOT REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'^(.*cp.*|ppc|retargeting|paid.*)$') THEN 'Organic Shopping'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(source, r'badoo|facebook|fb|instagram|linkedin|pinterest|tiktok|twitter|whatsapp')
        OR medium IN ('social', 'social-network', 'social-media', 'sm', 'social network', 'social media') THEN 'Organic Social'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(source, r'dailymotion|disneyplus|netflix|youtube|vimeo|twitch')
        OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'^(.*video.*)$') THEN 'Organic Video'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(source, 'baidu|bing|duckduckgo|ecosia|google|yahoo|yandex')
        OR medium = 'organic' THEN 'Organic Search'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'referral' THEN 'Referral'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(source, r'email|e-mail|e_mail|e mail') OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'email|e-mail|e_mail|e mail') THEN 'Email'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'affiliate' THEN 'Affiliates'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'audio' THEN 'Audio'
      WHEN source = 'sms' OR LOWER(medium) = 'sms' THEN 'SMS'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, 'push$') OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, 'mobile') OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, 'notification') THEN 'Mobile Push Notifications'
      ELSE 'Unassigned'
    END AS channel
  FROM session_traffic
  WHERE rn = 1
)

    i.user_pseudo_id,

    u.uninstall_timestamp,
    CASE 
      WHEN u.uninstall_timestamp IS NOT NULL 
        AND u.uninstall_timestamp > i.install_timestamp

-- Full query: For each quickplay event type, calculate retention rate
-- Retention = users with session_start in days 8-14 after first engagement / total users with that quickplay type

WITH 
-- Users whose first event was between Aug 1-15
cohort_users AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    MIN(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', event_date)) AS first_engagement_date
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180801' AND '20180815'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
  HAVING MIN(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', event_date)) >= '2018-08-01' 
     AND MIN(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', event_date)) <= '2018-08-15'
),

-- For each user in cohort, find their first quickplay event type
user_first_quickplay AS (
  SELECT 
    c.user_pseudo_id,
    c.first_engagement_date,
    e.event_name AS quickplay_event_type
  FROM cohort_users c
  JOIN `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` e
    ON c.user_pseudo_id = e.user_pseudo_id
    AND e.event_name LIKE '%quickplay%'
    AND e._TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180801' AND '20180831'
  GROUP BY c.user_pseudo_id, c.first_engagement_date, e.event_name
),

-- Users who had session_start in second week (days 8-14) after their first engagement
retained_users AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    uq.user_pseudo_id,
    uq.quickplay_event_type
  FROM user_first_quickplay uq
  JOIN `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` e
    ON uq.user_pseudo_id = e.user_pseudo_id
    AND e.event_name = 'session_start'
    AND PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', e.event_date) >= DATE_ADD(uq.first_engagement_date, INTERVAL 8 DAY)
    AND PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', e.event_date) <= DATE_ADD(uq.first_engagement_date, INTERVAL 14 DAY)
)

SELECT 
  uq.quickplay_event_type,
  COUNT(DISTINCT uq.user_pseudo_id) AS total_users,
  COUNT(DISTINCT r.user_pseudo_id) AS retained_users,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT r.user_pseudo_id), COUNT(DISTINCT uq.user_pseudo_id)) AS retention_rate
FROM user_first_quickplay uq
LEFT JOIN retained_users r
  ON uq.user_pseudo_id = r.user_pseudo_id
  AND uq.quickplay_event_type = r.quickplay_event_type
GROUP BY uq.quickplay_event_type
ORDER BY retention_rate ASC
